description: Delete one of your watches. Its webhook stops immediately and its delivery log is removed; this cannot be undone, but you can create a new watch with watch_road. Get the id from list_watches or from the watch_road result. Returns an error if no watch with that id belongs to your key. Needs a key.

id.description: Watch id from list_watches or watch_road.

name: unwatch_road
title: Stop watching a road
